blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/
blocks.zh: 随着联合音频-视频生成模型的能力增强,它们可以生成显示三种形式复杂性的视听场景:多事件组成,多层音频混合,以及不对称的跨模式关系. 然而,目前的评价基本上重复使用早先简单和单向任务的衡量标准。 他们通常会整体评价一个音频-视频剪辑,并依靠简单的预先定义的关系,使它们不适合这些日益复杂的场景. 我们提出一个以事件为中心的评价框架,将事件层面的视听事件分解,独立分析每个事件,跨模式交叉验证关系,将判断汇总为一个粗糙到精细的,三级的一致性度量. 衡量标准评估了全球的叙事和谐、事件层面的时间同步和精细的属性协调,为不同代间环境和跨模式关系的音频-视频一致性评价提供了一般的表述。 我们用AVC-Reward作为衡量标准, 一个训练有素的音频视频奖励模式。 为了评价自动判断与人类对代际范式的看法和关系复杂性之间的一致,我们构建了AVC-Benchmark,它主要是由各种音频视频生成模型生成的各种正反分样而来. AVC-Reward在自动方法中实现了与人类判断的先进一致,提供了可解释的将故障本地化的理由,并改进了联合生成模型作为在线增强学习信号时的音频-视频一致性. 项目网页:https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Audio-video generation has evolved from unidirectional driving toward joint generation with increasingly strong generative capabilities. Earlier audio-driven video generation (e.g., Wav2Lip ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ) ) and video-to-audio generation (e.g., HunyuanVideo-Foley ( Shan et al., 2025 ) ) were centered on more constrained consistency relations: the former mainly focused on lip synchronization ( Chung and Zisserman, 2016 ) , while the latter mainly focused on simple temporal alignment ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, joint generation removes the constraint of a fixed modality, with recent models such as Veo 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) and Seedance 2.0 ( Seedance et al., 2026 ) extending this paradigm to richer and more complex scenes.
blocks.zh: 音频视频生成已经从单向驱动发展到联合生成,其基因能力越来越强。 早期由音频驱动的视频生成(如:Wav2Lip (Prajwal等,2020年))和视频到音频生成(如:HunyuanVideo-Foley (Shan等,2025年))以更受制约的一致性关系为中心:前者主要关注唇相同步(Chung和Zisserman,2016年),而后者主要关注于简单的时间对接(Iachin等,2024年). 相形之下,联合生成消除了固定模式的制约,近期的模型有:Veo 3 (Google DeepMind, 2025),MiniMax H3(MiniMax, 2026)和Speedance 2.0(Speedance等, 2026)将这一范式扩展到更丰富更复杂的场景.

blocks.en: These richer audio-visual scenes exhibit three forms of complexity: multi-event composition , multi-layer audio mixture , and asymmetric cross-modal relations . First, a clip can contain multiple events that together form a complete scene, with several events potentially occurring at the same time. Second, its audio track can mix physical scene sounds with post-produced audio such as voice-over and background music, which instead support the video’s narrative or atmosphere. Third, audio and visual events need not follow a simple one-to-one relation: valid audio events such as off-screen sounds may lack direct visible visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 这些较丰富的视听场景呈现出三种形式的复杂性:多事件组成、多层次的音频混合和不对称的跨模式关系。 首先,一个剪辑可以包含多个事件,它们共同构成一个完整的场景,几个事件可能同时发生. 其次,它的音频音轨可以将物理场景声音与后出品的音频相混合,如语音翻唱和背景音乐,相反支持视频的叙事或氛围. 第三,音频和视觉事件不需要遵循简单的一对一关系:有效的音频事件,如外屏声音可能缺乏直接可见的视觉证据.

blocks.en:
However, evaluation methodologies have not kept pace with this evolution: the richer audio-visual content produced by joint models has made consistency evaluation more demanding.
Current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks, where one modality was fixed and only a limited relation such as lip–speech or sound–action timing needed to be checked; accordingly, they often evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations such as semantic similarity or temporal synchronization. Multi-event composition makes such clip-level evaluation unreliable because different event relations are entangled; for example, ImageBind-based metrics ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) encode the audio and video within a clip or temporal window into a shared embedding space and measure their overall similarity, which can remain high when dominant semantics match despite a local event inconsistency. Multi-layer audio mixture further complicates evaluation: metrics such as Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) predict an audio–video temporal offset from the mixed soundtrack without separating its layers. When physical sounds are mixed with voice-over or background music, sounds that should align with visible actions are evaluated together with audio that does not require such temporal correspondence, which can lead to an inaccurate consistency score. Complex cross-modal relations further challenge predefined matching rules; for example, AV-Align ( Yariv et al., 2024 ) matches audio onsets with visual-motion peaks and may therefore penalize a valid off-screen sound that lacks direct visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
然而,评价方法没有跟上这一变化:联合模式制作的更丰富的视听内容使一致性评价更加严格。
目前的评价大多是重复使用早先简单和单向任务的衡量标准,其中一种方式是固定的,只需要检查唇语或声音动作时间等有限的关系;因此,它们往往从整体上评价一个音频视频片段,并依赖诸如语义相似或时间同步等简单的预先定义的关系。 多事件构成使得这种剪辑级别的评价不可靠,因为不同的事件关系被缠绕;例如,基于ImageBind的度量衡(Girdhar等,2023;Mao等,2024;Liu等,2025)将剪辑或时间窗口内的音频和视频编码为共享嵌入空间并测量其整体相似性,当主导语义匹配时,尽管局部事件不一致,其高度仍可保持高. 多层音频混合物使评价更加复杂:Synchformer(Iachin等,2024年)等度量衡预测一个音频-视频时间与混合音轨相抵消,而不分离其分层. 当物理声音被混入语音或背景音乐时,应当与可见动作相配合的声音与不需要这种时间性对应的音频一起被评价,这可能导致不准确的一致性分数. 复杂的跨模式关系进一步挑战了预先定义的匹配规则;例如,AV-Align(Yariv等,2024年)将音频发音与可视运动峰相匹配,因此可能会处罚一个没有直接视觉证据的有效外屏声音.

blocks.en:
Therefore, we need a more general audio-video consistency evaluator that can handle diverse event relations across different generation paradigms, particularly in modern joint generation.
Moreover, we believe that such an evaluation model can serve as a training signal to directly improve generation models, closing the loop of “generate–evaluate–optimize.”
blocks.zh:
因此,我们需要一个更普通的音频视频一致性评价员,能够处理不同代相间的多种事件关系,特别是在现代联合代相.
此外,我们认为,这种评价模式可以作为培训信号,直接改进生成模式,并结束“基因评估”的循环。 “

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed event-centric audio-video consistency evaluation framework.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议以事件为中心的音频视频一致性评价框架概览。

blocks.en:
To meet this need, we propose an event-centric evaluation perspective, in which the audio and video of each generated clip are first disentangled into individual events and analyzed independently before the final judgments.
Under this perspective, we first separately extract and analyze audio and visual events, then cross-validate their relations across modalities, and finally aggregate the resulting judgments from coarse to fine.
We formulate this final consistency assessment as a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric . Global narrative harmony assesses whether the audio and video form a coherent scene and narrative. Event-level temporal synchronization establishes event relations, checks event presence and temporal alignment, and marks audio events without visual evidence. Fine-grained attribute alignment verifies the attributes of matched events and assesses whether marked audio is plausibly an off-screen sound, voice-over, or background music.
By disentangling individual events, distinguishing different audio sources, and explicitly validating their cross-modal relations, this metric can separately assess overlapping events, handle audio layers with different roles, and accommodate valid asymmetric relations, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh:
为了满足这一需要,我们提出了一个以事件为中心的评价视角,其中每个生成的片段的音频和视频首先被分解为单个事件,并在最终判决前独立分析.
在这个角度下,我们首先分别提取和分析视听事件,然后交叉验证其跨模式的关系,最后将由此产生的判断从粗糙归纳为细微.
我们制定这一最终一致性评估是粗略的、三级一致性衡量标准。 全球叙事和谐度评估音频和视频是否形成连贯的场景和叙事. 事件级时间同步建立事件关系,检查事件存在和时间对接,并标记没有视觉证据的音频事件. 精细的属性校正验证相匹配事件的属性,并评估所标记的音频是否是脱屏声音,语音翻唱或背景音乐的可信.
通过区分单个事件,区分不同的音频来源,并明确验证其跨模式关系,这一衡量标准可以分别评估重叠事件,处理具有不同作用的音频层,并适应有效的不对称关系,如图1所示.

blocks.en:
Based on this event-level perspective, we implement the above three-level metric as a trainable audio-video reward model, named AVC-Reward , initialized from Qwen3-Omni-Thinking ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . AVC-Reward implements the metric through a five-stage structured reasoning chain consisting of audio(/video)-only analysis, cross-modal verification, and overall judgment.
Its training data includes audio-video samples from different generation paradigms and models, with annotations from multiple expert MLLMs and human annotators, while its two-stage training procedure uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to cold-start the structured evaluation process and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to align the scoring with human preferences.
Meanwhile, to measure the agreement between audio-video consistency metrics and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct an audio-video consistency benchmark, AVC-Benchmark . To our knowledge, it is the first audio-video consistency benchmark primarily built from diverse samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models.
blocks.zh:
基于这一事件层面的视角,我们实施以上三级度量衡,作为可被训练的音频-视频奖励模式,命名为AVC-Reward. 从Qune3-Omni-Thinking(徐等,2025. AVC-Reward通过由音频(/视频)唯一分析、跨模式核查和总体判断组成的五阶段结构化推理链执行该衡量标准。
其培训数据包括来自不同世代范式和模型的音频-视频样本,并附有多位专家MLLM和人文注释员的说明;而其两阶段培训程序则采用有监督地微调(SFT)来冷启动结构化评价过程和团体相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等,2024年)来将评分与人类偏好相配合.
同时,为了衡量音频-视频一致性指标与人类对一代人范式的看法和关系复杂性之间的一致,我们构建了音频-视频一致性基准——AVC-Benchmark。 据我们所知,这是第一个音频视频一致性基准,主要来自各种音频视频生成模型产生的各种样本。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the reward model from two complementary perspectives. For evaluation effectiveness , it achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment on AVC-Benchmark, and unlike a black-box scalar, it provides interpretable, structured natural-language rationales that localize where a generation fails (e.g., a temporally misaligned event or a hallucinated sound). For usability as a reward , applying it as a training signal for the online reinforcement-learning fine-tuning ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) of a joint generation model LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) measurably improves the audio-video consistency of generated outputs, demonstrating that it closes the optimization loop.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We formalize audio-video consistency across generation paradigms with an event-centric, three-level metric designed to handle complex generated scenes. • We instantiate this metric as a trainable audio-video reward model built on the Qwen3-Omni-Thinking ( Xu et al., 2025 ) model with rigorous event-level verification. • We construct AVC-Benchmark for reproducible human-alignment evaluation, and validate the reward model both as an interpretable automatic evaluator and as an effective training signal that improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model .
blocks.zh:
我们从两个互补的角度评价奖励模式。 对于评价的有效性,它实现了与人类对AVC-Benchmark的判断最先进的一致,并且与黑盒斯卡勒不同,它提供了可解释的,结构化的自然语言原理,将一代人失败的地方(如时间错位的事件或幻觉的声音)本地化. 作为奖励的可用性,应用它作为联合生成模式LTX-2(HaCohen等,2026年)在线增强-学习微调(Zhang等,2026年a)的培训信号,可以大大地提高所生成产出的音频-视频一致性,表明它关闭了优化循环.
• 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们正式确定跨代范式的音频-视频一致性,并采用以事件为中心、三级的衡量标准,处理复杂的生成场景。 我们立即将这一衡量标准作为可训练的音频视频奖励模式,该模式建立在Qune3-Omni-Thinking(徐等,2025年)模式上,并有严格的事件级别核查。 我们构建AVC-Benchmark,用于可复制的人类对接评价,并验证奖励模式,既作为可解释的自动评价者,又作为提高联合生成模式的音频-视频一致性的有效培训信号。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Audio-video generation first developed through audio-driven video generation ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) and video-to-audio generation ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Shan et al., 2025 ) , where one modality is fixed.
Joint audio-video generation (JAVG) removes this constraint: early works either learned a joint generative process ( Ruan et al., 2023 ) or coordinated pretrained unimodal generators ( Xing et al., 2024 ) .
Native JAVG then advanced toward open-ended generation, finer synchronization, and richer audio content, as represented by JavisDiT ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , Ovi ( Low et al., 2025 ) , UniVerse-1 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) .
JAVG has further reached industrial-scale deployment through systems such as Veo 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , Seedance 2.0 ( Seedance et al., 2026 ) , and MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , enabling the generation of more complex audio-visual scenes with multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixtures, and complex cross-modal relations, which makes audio-video consistency evaluation more demanding.

blocks.zh: 表1:现代JAVG所暴露挑战的音频视频一致性度量比较.

blocks.en:
Existing audio-video consistency metrics and their limitations under modern joint audio-video generation are summarized in Table 1 .
Early metrics target specific consistency relations: SyncNet measures lip–speech synchrony, AV-Align matches motion and audio peaks, and DeSync predicts temporal offsets.
ImageBind, AVHScore, and JavisScore measure cross-modal similarity at clip, frame–audio, or temporal-window granularity.
PEAVS and AVBench learn human preferences from manually created errors.
AGAV-Rater and Beyond Time Shifts further learn from real V2A outputs.
Recent analysis further shows that existing metrics focus on different aspects of consistency and exhibit low cross-metric agreement ( Sharma and Tapadiya, 2026 ) . Together, these methods remain tied to specific tasks or relations, making them insufficient for general audio-video consistency evaluation under the complexity of modern joint generation.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价概览

blocks.en:
The complexities exposed by modern joint generation introduce three requirements for evaluation.
Multi-event composition calls for event disentanglement , so that individual and overlapping events can be examined separately.
Multi-layer audio mixture requires the evaluator to distinguish the roles of different audio events , as different audio sources can have different relations to the video.
Asymmetric and diverse cross-modal relations further require establishing and verifying event-dependent cross-modal relations for individual events.
blocks.zh:
现代联合一代暴露出的复杂性对评价提出了三项要求。
多事件组成要求事件分解,这样单个事件和相重叠事件就可以单独审查.
多层音频混合物要求评价者区分不同音频事件的作用,因为不同的音频源可能与视频有不同的关系.
不对称和多样化的跨模式关系进一步要求建立和核实个别事件依赖事件的不同模式关系。

blocks.en: Meeting these requirements requires an evaluator capable of jointly understanding audio-visual content and reasoning over different events and their relations. MLLMs with audio-video understanding capabilities can jointly perform these tasks within a unified reasoning process, making them a suitable foundation for audio-video consistency evaluation.
blocks.zh: 满足这些要求需要有一个能够共同理解视听内容和对不同事件及其关系的推理的评价人员。 具有音频-视频理解能力的MLLMs可以在统一的推理过程中共同完成这些任务,使这些任务成为音频-视频一致性评价的合适基础.

blocks.en:
Moreover, for more general and accurate evaluation, we argue that the judgments of the MLLM should be organized into an event-centric metric with three coarse-to-fine levels . Global narrative harmony first checks whether the audio and video are coherent across the full clip. Event-level temporal synchronization and fine-grained attribute alignment then move to the event level.
They respectively assess the temporal alignment of each event and the consistency of audio-visual attributes within that event.
Through event-level evaluation and detailed, independent verification of each event’s cross-modal relations, the metric addresses the higher evaluation demands above.
blocks.zh:
此外,为了进行更普遍和更准确的评估,我们主张,应当将劳动和劳工部的判断组织成一个以事件为中心的衡量标准,分为三个粗到细的级别。 全球叙事和谐首先检查整个片段的音频和视频是否一致. 事件级时间同步和细纹属性对接后移动到事件级.
它们分别评估每一事件的时间一致性以及该事件内视听特性的一致性。
通过活动一级的评价和对每个活动的跨模式关系的详细、独立核查,衡量标准满足了上述较高的评价要求。

blocks.en:
Following Section 3.1 , we define three-level consistency scores. Global narrative harmony ( S mac S_{\mathrm{mac}} ) measures agreement in narrative content, entities, environment, and affective tone. Event-level temporal synchronization ( S temp S_{\mathrm{temp}} ) measures event presence and the alignment of onset, offset, and duration under the appropriate cross-modal relations. Fine-grained attribute alignment ( S attr S_{\mathrm{attr}} ) measures attribute compatibility within verified relations, including sound–material agreement, lip-shape agreement with speech, and plausible responses to off-screen sounds.
All three scores lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with higher values indicating greater consistency.

blocks.en:
Our training data includes outputs from existing joint audio-video, audio-driven video, and video-to-audio generation models. We further add a small number of manually edited global-narrative negatives in GRPO to balance the distribution of failure cases. The overall pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 2 .
We provide two complementary forms of supervision: structured reasoning data teaches the model to follow the event-centric evaluation protocol for SFT, while human-calibrated data aligns its scores with human judgment for GRPO.
The complete data sources and calibration details are provided in App. B .

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 基准

blocks.en: We construct AVC-Benchmark to evaluate how well automatic audio-video consistency metrics align with human perception in realistic generation scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了AVC-Benchmark,以评估在现实的生成情景中自动音频视频一致性指标如何与人类的认知相匹配.

blocks.en:
AVC-Benchmark is the first benchmark, to our knowledge, that primarily uses various types of model-generated audio-video data to evaluate the alignment between automatic consistency metrics and human perception.
It contains samples from A2V, V2A, and JAVG models, together with a small set of controlled negatives added to balance the failure-case distribution and broaden the coverage of audio-video inconsistencies.
Each sample is independently annotated by three annotators, providing human ground-truth scores on the three consistency dimensions defined in Section 3.2 .
We evaluate each metric against these human scores using pairwise accuracy under different score-difference thresholds, Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient (SRCC), and Pearson’s linear correlation coefficient (PLCC).
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,AVC-Benchmark是第一个主要使用各类模型生成的音频视频数据来评价自动一致性度量衡与人类感知的一致性的基准.
它包含了来自A2V,V2A,和JAVG模型的样本,并加上了一小组可控底片来平衡出故障的分布并拓宽音频-视频不一致的覆盖范围.
每个样本由三个注释员独立注释,就第3.2节所定义的三个一致性维度提供人地真相分数。
我们使用不同分数差阈值下的双向精确度、斯皮尔曼的分级相关系数(SRCC)和皮尔逊的线性相关系数(PLCC)来对照这些人类分数来评估每个公分。

blocks.en:
Detailed benchmark statistics are provided in App. D.2 .
In general, most samples retain high global scene and narrative consistency, providing a meaningful basis for evaluating finer temporal and attribute-level relations; accordingly, the latter two dimensions span much broader score ranges.
The annotated failures further cover global narrative, affective, and environmental conflicts; temporal errors across physical events, speech, and music; and fine-grained mismatches in material, morphology, and causal response.
blocks.zh:
详细的基准统计载于App.D.2。
一般来说,大多数样本保持了高全球场景和叙事一致性,为评价更细化的时间和属性层面的关系提供了有意义的基础;因此后两个维度跨越了更广阔的分数范围.
附加说明的失败还涉及全球叙事、情感和环境冲突;物理事件、言论和音乐之间的时间误差;以及材料、形态和因果反应方面的细微错配。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We study general audio-video consistency evaluation under the challenges of multi-event composition , multi-layer audio mixture , and asymmetric cross-modal relations . We propose an event-centric coarse-to-fine three-level metric and instantiate it as AVC-Reward , trained with structured SFT and human-aligned GRPO. We further introduce AVC-Benchmark to evaluate human agreement across diverse audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves the strongest human alignment among evaluated methods and, when integrated into OmniNFT, effectively improves audio-video consistency. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of event-centric consistency evaluation as both a reliable metric and an optimization signal for joint audio-video generation.
blocks.zh: 在多事件构成、多层次音频混合和不对称的跨模式关系的挑战下,我们研究一般音频视频一致性评价。 我们提出一个以事件为中心的粗细到精细的三层度量衡,并将其作为AVC-Reward(英语:AVC-Reward),经过结构化的SFT和人相通的GRPO的训练. 我们进一步引入了AVC-Benchmark来评价不同音频视频生成模型中的人类协议. AVC-Reward在被评价方法之间实现了最强的人类一致性,并被整合入OmniNFT后能有效地提高音频-视频的一致性. 这些结果表明,以事件为中心的一致性评价是可靠的衡量尺度,也是联合音频视频生成的优化信号。

blocks.en:
We construct two data pools for AVC-Reward training, one for structured-reasoning SFT and the other for human calibration. Table 5 summarizes the sources and statistics of the training data used for SFT and GRPO.
Throughout this process, a wide array of multimodal models ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Low et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026b ; Tu et al., 2024 ; Tu et al., 2025a ; Tu et al., 2025b ; Shan et al., 2025 ; Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) is leveraged to curate more comprehensive data along with precise annotations.

我们为AVC-Reward训练建造了两个数据库,一个用于结构合理的SFT,另一个用于人类校正。 表5汇总了SFT和GPRO使用的培训数据的来源和统计数据。
在整个过程中,多种多式联运模式(徐等,2025;低等,2025;Team等,2026;Pan等,2025;Pan等,2026b;Tu等,2024;Tu等,2025a; Tu等人,2025b; 利用Shan等人,2025年;Girdhar等人,2023年;Yang等人,2025年b;Liu等人,2025年)来整理更全面的数据以及准确的说明。

blocks.en: We first collect ground-truth audio-video clips from two categories: general scenes and human-centered scenes. We use Qwen3-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025 ) to filter the clips for basic audio-video quality and clarity, salient event and temporal relations, and informative macro-semantic content, retaining 2.5k general clips and 1k human-centered clips. The four filtering questions are provided in our project’s GitHub repository. Qwen3-Omni then generates audio and video captions for the retained clips, which are used to construct samples under different generation paradigms.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从一般场景和以人为中心的场景这两个类别收集地面真实的录音录像片段。 我们利用Qune3-Omni(徐等,2025年)过滤剪辑基本音频视频质量和清晰度,突出事件和时间关系,以及信息丰富的宏观语义内容,保留了2.5k通取剪辑和以人为中心的1克剪辑. 我们的GitHub仓库提供了四个过滤问题。 Qune3-Omni再为所保留的片段生成音频和视频字幕,这些片段用于构建不同世代范式下的样本.

blocks.en: For the general subset, Ovi ( Low et al., 2025 ) generates 2.5k JAVG samples from full audio-video captions, while HunyuanVideo-Foley ( Shan et al., 2025 ) generates 2.5k V2A samples from the ground-truth videos and corresponding audio captions. For the human-centered subset, Ovi generates 1k JAVG samples, while InfiniteTalk ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and an internal model each generate 1k A2V samples using the ground-truth audio with visual conditioning. Together with the 3.5k ground-truth clips, this gives 11.5k candidate samples. We further filter the generated pool for basic audio-video quality and annotation completeness, retaining 8k clips for SFT.

blocks.en:
We construct the human-calibration source pool from JavisBench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Its relatively large scale, paired ground-truth references, and broad content coverage provide a practical starting point for constructing diverse positive and negative examples when high-quality audio-video data remain limited.
We sample 3.2k clips from each of five sources: JavisBench ground truth, Ovi-I2V, Ovi-T2V, HunyuanVideo-Foley, and an internal A2V model. The generated samples use the corresponding JavisBench inputs, covering JAVG, V2A, and A2V paradigms. These 16k clips form the initial candidate pool. We run the SFT model f 1 f_{1} eight times on each candidate to estimate sample difficulty and prioritize cases for which the model has not yet formed stable judgments. To preserve content diversity, we cluster ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) audio-video embeddings into 300 clusters and sample across clusters. We also construct global-narrative negatives by swapping audio tracks across clusters. Finally, we sample original candidates and constructed global negatives at a 3:1 ratio to obtain the 10k rollout set used for GRPO.

blocks.en: B.2 Five-Stage Automated Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.2 五相自动说明管道

blocks.en:
Informed by practical insights of prior approaches ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ; Leng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Mei et al., 2024 ) , To construct structured supervision at scale, we implement a five-stage automated annotation pipeline that first analyzes audio and video independently, then verifies event relations in both directions, and finally aggregates the structured evidence into the three consistency levels.
Table 6 summarizes the input, operation, tool, and output of each stage.
Fig. 6 illustrates the complete data flow.

blocks.en: Table 6 and Fig. 6 summarize the complete annotation procedure.
blocks.zh: 表6和图6概述了完整的注释程序。

blocks.en:
Stages 1 and 2 first parse the two modalities independently.
The audio branch separates speech, music, and other sound events, and records their scene context, speaker information, acoustic attributes, and timestamps.
The video branch extracts the global scene, people, emotions, and timestamped visual events that may be relevant to audio.
blocks.zh:
第1阶段和第2阶段首先独立分析两种模式。
音频分支将语音,音乐等声音事件分开,并记录其场景背景,扬声器信息,声学属性,以及时间戳.
视频分支提取出全球场景,人物,情感,以及可能与音频相关的有时间戳的视觉事件.

blocks.en:
Stages 3 and 4 then perform bidirectional event verification.
For each audio event, audio-to-video verification searches its temporal window for supporting visual evidence and, when applicable, examines temporal alignment and fine-grained physical attributes.
The absence of a visible source is retained as evidence rather than directly treated as an inconsistency, allowing later reasoning over off-screen audio and other asymmetric relations.
Conversely, video-to-audio verification first determines whether a visual event should naturally produce sound.
Naturally silent actions are preserved as reasonable silence, while sound-producing actions are checked for corresponding acoustic evidence, temporal alignment, and physical compatibility.
blocks.zh:
然后进行双向事件核查。
对于每个音频事件,音频到视频的核查搜索其时间窗口,以作为视觉证据的佐证,并在适用时审查时间对接和精细的物理属性.
缺少可见来源被保留为证据,而不是直接作为不一致处理,因此以后可以对屏幕外的音频和其他不对称关系进行推理。
反之,视频对音频验证首先决定了视觉事件是否应该自然产生声音.
自然而然地,沉默的行动被保留为合理的沉默,而产生声音的行动则被检查相应的声学证据,时间相接,以及物理相容性.

blocks.en:
Stage 5 aggregates the modality-specific analyses and the two directional verification records.
The evaluator also re-examines the original audio-video clip instead of relying only on intermediate annotations.
It then produces scores for global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, together with a diagnostic conclusion that summarizes the main consistent or inconsistent events.
blocks.zh:
第5阶段汇总了具体方式的分析和两个方向核查记录。
评价人员还重新审视了原声视频片段,而不是只依赖中间说明.
然后产生全球叙事和谐的分数,事件级时间同步,和细纹属性对接,同时得出一个诊断结论,总结出主要一致或不一致的事件.

blocks.en:
The three evaluation levels require several non-trivial judgments, so we do not rely on a single unconstrained model response to construct the supervision.
Instead, the annotation harness introduces explicit process controls around the underlying expert models.
First, audio and video are analyzed independently, preventing early cross-modal information from directly biasing event discovery.
Second, each detected event is converted into explicit timestamps and evidence records, and later checks operate on these records rather than restarting from an unconstrained global judgment.
Third, verification is conditional: existence is checked before temporal or attribute compatibility, and inapplicable cases such as reasonable silence are explicitly bypassed.
Fourth, the same relation is checked in both audio-to-video and video-to-audio directions, providing a cross-check for missing and hallucinated events.
Finally, the aggregation stage receives all intermediate evidence but also re-examines the original audio-video clip, forming a final feedback check against errors propagated from earlier stages.
blocks.zh:
这三个评价级别需要若干非三角判断,因此我们不依赖单一的不受约束的模型反应来构建监督.
相反,注解手段引入了围绕基本专家模型的明确流程控制。
首先,音频和视频独立分析,防止早期跨模式信息直接偏向事件发现.
其次,每个被检测出的事件被转换成明确的时间戳和证据记录,后来对这些记录进行核对,而不是从不受约束的全球判断中重新开始.
第三,核查是有条件的:在时间或属性相容之前先检查存在,而诸如合理沉默等不适用的情况被明确绕过.
第四,在音频到视频和视频到视频方向均检查同一关系,为缺失和幻觉事件提供交叉检查.
最后,汇总阶段接收所有中间证据,但也重新审查原声视频片段,形成针对从早期传播出的错误的最终反馈检查.

blocks.en:
These controlled verification records are then transferred to AVC-Reward through both training stages.
During SFT, the complete five-stage annotation trajectory, including single-modal analyses, bidirectional event verification, three scores, and the diagnostic conclusion, is used as the full supervision target.
The model is therefore trained to reproduce the same staged verification process rather than learning only a direct mapping from the input clip to final scores.
During GRPO, the structure reward explicitly rewards the presence of all five reasoning stages, while score distillation aligns the resulting judgments with human-calibrated scores.
Together, the two stages preserve the verification procedure established by the annotation harness while transferring it from the cascaded expert pipeline into a single reward model.
Whether this learned procedure leads to correct judgments is further evaluated through human alignment, training ablations, and qualitative cases.
blocks.zh:
这些受控核查记录随后通过两个培训阶段转移到奥地利核查团——奖励。
在SFT期间,完整的五级注释轨迹,包括单模式分析,双向事件验证,三分分分和诊断结论被作为全监督目标.
因此,该模型经过培训,可以复制相同的分阶段核查程序,而不是只学习从输入片段到最终分数的直接绘图。
在GRPO期间,结构奖励明确奖励所有五个推理阶段的出现,而分数分数分数则将由此产生的判断与人类分数相协调.
这两个阶段共同维护了注解装置确立的核查程序,同时将其从级联专家管道转移到单一的奖励模式。
通过人员配对、培训以及定性案例,进一步评估这一经过学习的程序是否导致正确的判断。

blocks.en: B.3 Human Annotation and Score Calibration
blocks.zh: B.3 人类注释和分数校正

blocks.en:
In human annotation, we found that score-only judgments showed noticeable subjective variation and made disagreements difficult to verify.
We therefore design a 39-label taxonomy that asks annotators to record explicit consistency states and failure types before score calibration, reducing unconstrained subjectivity while preserving observable information about event presence, timing, audio roles, and cross-modal relations.
The taxonomy follows the same three dimensions as AVC-Reward: global labels cover narrative, affective, and environmental consistency; temporal labels separately describe physical interactions, speaker events, and music/rhythmic events, including missing, hallucinated, off-screen, and narrative-layer cases; fine-grained labels describe material, intensity, spatial, motion, and causal-response attributes.
Table 7 summarizes the complete annotation space.
blocks.zh:
在人的说明中,我们发现,只得分的判断显示出明显的主观差异,使分歧难以核实。
因此,我们设计了一个39个标签的分类法,要求注释者在分数校正前记录明确的一致性状态和故障类型,减少不受限制的主观性,同时保存关于事件存在、时间、音频角色和跨模式关系的可观察信息。
分类法遵循与AVC-Reward相同的三个维度:全局标签涵盖叙事,情感,以及环境的一致性;时间标签分别描述物理相互作用,扬声器事件,和音乐/韵律事件,包括缺失,幻觉,外屏,叙事层等;细纹标签描述材料,强度,空间,运动,和因果反应属性等.
表7概述了完整的注释空间。

blocks.en:
Table 7: Human annotation taxonomy with 39 labels.
Global narrative harmony evaluates clip-level narrative and scene coherence; event-level temporal synchronization separately covers physical interactions, speaker events, and music or rhythmic events; fine-grained attribute alignment examines the internal audio-visual attributes of temporally matched events.
blocks.zh:
表7:有39个标签的人类注释分类学.
全球叙事和谐评价了剪辑层面的叙事和场景一致性;事件层面的时间同步分别涵盖物理互动,扬声器事件,以及音乐或节奏事件;精细的属性对接检查了时间相匹配事件的内部视听属性.

blocks.en:
Annotators judge the three dimensions independently.
Within each dimension, all applicable failure labels can be selected, allowing a clip to contain multiple inconsistency types or multiple affected events.
For temporal synchronization, annotators additionally distinguish physical-layer on-screen events, plausible off-screen events, and narrative-layer audio such as voice-over and background music.
A severe global conflict can be marked as unjudgeable for a later event-level category when the corresponding relation cannot be meaningfully assessed, but this does not otherwise propagate the global judgment to the other dimensions.
blocks.zh:
注释者独立判断出三个维度.
在每个维度内,可以选择所有可应用的故障标签,允许一个剪辑包含多个不一致类型或多个受影响的事件.
对于时间同步,注释者在屏幕上额外区分了物理层事件,假想的屏幕外事件,以及语音翻转和背景音乐等叙事层音频.
当无法对相应关系进行有意义的评估时,严重的全球冲突可被标为无法判断的后一事件类别,但这并不能将全球判断推广到其他方面。

blocks.en:
For each annotated sample, three annotators independently provide the dimension labels.
The training and test sets are strictly disjoint.
The held-out test set is additionally assigned to annotators who do not participate in labeling the training set, preventing overlap in both samples and annotators between model training and final human evaluation.
blocks.zh:
对于每个有注释的样本,三个注释器独立提供尺寸标签.
培训与测试设备严格脱节。
被搁置的测试集被额外分配给不参与给培训集贴上标签的注释者,防止样本和注释者在模型培训和最终人类评价之间重叠.

blocks.en: Human annotations provide detailed categorical supervision, while AVC-Reward requires continuous targets for the three dimensions. Directly collecting continuous scores for all training samples introduces annotation subjectivity and variance, making large-scale score supervision difficult to verify and maintain consistently. Therefore, we investigate whether human-verified labels can serve as an intermediate representation for recovering continuous scores.
blocks.zh: 人文说明提供了详细的绝对监督,而AVC-Reward则需要持续针对三个层面的目标. 直接收集所有培训样本的连续分数,引入了注释主观性和差异性,使得大规模分数监督难以始终如一地进行核实和维护. 因此,我们调查经人验证的标签是否可以作为恢复连续分数的中间代表.

blocks.en: We first study the relationship between human-verified labels and continuous scores on AVC-Benchmark, where both label annotations and human score annotations are available. We analyze whether label configurations consistently correspond to similar human scores. Pairs sharing the same human-verified label configuration have an average absolute score difference of only 0.0321 (median 0.0111), compared with 0.2002 (median 0.1000) for pairs with different configurations (Table 8 ). This indicates that label configurations strongly constrain human scores and motivates label-to-score calibration for continuous reward construction.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在AVC-Benchmark上研究经人验证的标签和连续分数之间的关系,那里有标签说明和人类分数说明. 我们分析标签配置是否与类似的人类分数一致. 共享相同人验证标签配置的对等器的平均绝对分差只有0.0321分(中位数0.0111分),而配置不同的对等器则有0.202(中位数0.1000分). 这表明标签配置强烈地制约了人类的分数,并激励了标签到分数的校正,用于持续的奖励构建.

blocks.zh: 表8:具有相同或不同标签配置的样本对人得分的绝对差异.

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we further investigate whether a large language model can learn the label-to-score mapping through few-shot calibration. Specifically, we extract 10 representative label-to-score mappings from the AVC-Benchmark annotations and provide them to Qwen3-235B as few-shot demonstrations for score rewriting.

blocks.en: C.3 Generation-Side RL with AVC-Reward
blocks.zh: C.3. 带有AVC-奖励的一代系列RL

blocks.en:
To evaluate AVC-Reward as an optimization signal, we build on the generation-side RL framework of OmniNFT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
We keep the overall training framework unchanged and replace its original audio-video reward DeSync ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) with AVC-Reward, using its overall score S AVC S_{\mathrm{AVC}} as the optimization signal, with reward-specific learning-rate and weight adjustments for comparable optimization strength.
This isolates the effect of the proposed reward while retaining the original generation training setup.
blocks.zh:
为了评价AVC-Reward作为优化信号,我们借鉴了OmniNFT(张等等,2026a)的生成侧RL框架. 。 。 。 。
我们保持整体训练框架不变,并用AVC-Reward取代其原有的音频-视频奖励DeSync(Iachin等,2024年),取而代之的是AVC-Reward,取而代之的是其总体分数SAVC S_{\-mathrm{AVC}})作为优化信号,并采用奖励特定的学习率和重量调整来达到可比优化强度.
这隔离了拟议奖励的效果,同时保留了最初的一代培训设置.

blocks.en:
OmniNFT jointly optimizes audio quality, video quality, and audio-video consistency rewards; under the original weighting, AVC-Reward therefore has a weaker relative optimization effect than the original DeSync reward.
We use a two-stage schedule to compensate for this difference.
In Stage 1, we retain OmniNFT’s original learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , set the AVC-Reward weight to 2.0, and train for 600 steps.
In Stage 2, we reduce the learning rate to 1.5 × 10 − 5 1.5\times 10^{-5} and increase the other quality-reward weights, reducing the relative AVC-Reward weight to 1.2, and continue training for 275 steps.
This setup provides generation-side RL validation of AVC-Reward while retaining a direct controlled comparison with the original OmniNFT training framework.
blocks.zh:
OmniNFT联合优化了音频质量,视频质量,以及音频-视频一致性的奖励;因此在原加权法下,AVC-Reward的相对优化效果比原德辛克奖励弱.
我们用两个阶段的时间表来弥补这种差异。
在第一阶段,我们保留OmniNFT最初的学习率3×10−5 3\times 10×5},将AVC-奖励重量设定为2.0,并训练600步.
在第二阶段,我们把学习率降低到1.5×-10−5 1.5\tims 10×5}并增加其他质量奖励分量,将相对的AVC-奖励分量降低到1.2,继续训练275步.
这个设置为AVC-Reward提供了生成-侧RL验证,同时保留了与原OmniNFT训练框架的直接可控比较.

blocks.en: D.1 Benchmark Construction and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: D.1 基准建设和评价议定书

blocks.en:
We construct AVC-Benchmark through three complementary steps.
We first perform stratified sampling based on human label configurations to balance the coverage of major consistency and failure patterns, including global narrative conflicts, temporal offsets, missing or hallucinated audio, and fine-grained attribute mismatches.
We then use ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) to extract audio and video representations and cluster their joint embeddings, from which we sample across clusters to reduce semantic redundancy.
Finally, we add explicitly constructed negative samples to strengthen the coverage of controlled failure cases that are less frequent in naturally generated data.
blocks.zh:
我们通过三个互补步骤来构建AVC-Benchmark.
我们首先根据人类标签配置进行分层取样,以平衡主要一致性和失败模式的覆盖范围,包括全球叙事冲突,时间抵消,缺失或幻觉音频,以及精细的属性错配.
然后,我们使用ImageBind(Girdhar等,2023年)提取出音频和视频的表示并组合他们的联合嵌入,我们从中抽取跨组的样本来减少语义冗余.
最后,我们添加了明确构建的负面样本,以加强对自然生成数据中频率较低的控制故障案例的覆盖。

blocks.en:
The resulting benchmark contains 706 samples across different generation paradigms and data sources: 172 ground truth samples, 243 JAVG samples, 100 A2V samples, 72 V2A samples, and 119 samples from the explicit-negative construction set.
The JAVG subset contains Ovi-I2V, Ovi-T2V and Veo3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) outputs, the A2V subset is generated by an internal model, and the V2A subset is generated by HunyuanVideo-Foley.
blocks.zh:
由此产生的基准包含706个跨不同代范式和数据来源的样本:172个地真样本,243个JAVG样本,100个A2V样本,72个V2A样本,119个取自显阴性构造组.
JAVG子集包含Ovi-I2V,Ovi-T2V和Veo3(Google DeepMind,2025年)输出,A2V子集由内部模型生成,而V2A子集由HunyuanVideo-Foley生成.

blocks.en:
We construct additional controlled negatives from 50 Veo3 source clips.
Among them, 10 contain salient emotion or global narrative cues, 20 contain clear temporal relations, and 20 contain salient audio attributes.
We apply the edit operations in Table 14 to produce 119 negative samples.
These edits complement naturally occurring generation failures with controlled semantic, temporal, event-existence, and fine-grained acoustic inconsistencies, balancing the failure-case distribution and broadening coverage beyond naturally occurring generation failures.

其中,10个包含显著的情感或全球叙事提示,20个包含清晰的时间关系,20个包含显著的音频属性.
我们采用表14中的编辑操作来生成119个负面样本.
这些编辑用受控制的语义、时间、事件存在和精细的相声不一致来补充自然发生的生成故障,平衡了故障的分布,将覆盖面扩大到自然发生的生成故障之外。

blocks.en:
Each benchmark sample is independently evaluated by three annotators following the 39-label protocol in Appendix B.3 .
The benchmark annotators do not overlap with those used for the training set.
Rather than directly assigning scores, annotators first inspect the three dimensions independently and select all applicable labels before providing the corresponding scores.
This label-first protocol requires explicit checks of the relevant event existence, timing, attributes, and relation types, making the annotation process more traceable and reducing unconstrained score judgments.
Annotators then assign a score from 0 to 1, with a step size of 0.1, for global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment.
blocks.zh:
每个基准样本由三个注释员按照附录B.3中的39个标签协议进行独立评估。
基准注释员与培训组所用的注释员不相重叠。
注释者不是直接分配分数,而是首先独立检查三个维度,并在提供相应的分数之前选择所有可适用的标签.
这个标签-第一协议要求明确检查相关的事件存在,时间,属性,以及关系类型,使注释过程更能被追踪,并减少不受约束的分数判断.
注释者然后将分数从0分到1分,分数为0.1分,用于全球叙事和谐,事件级时间同步,以及精细的属性对齐.

blocks.en:
We use agreement among the three annotators’ label records within each sample as an additional quality-control signal before constructing the final benchmark reference.
We further quantify inter-annotator agreement on the retained annotations, obtaining ICC(2,k) of 0.83, Krippendorff’s α \alpha of 0.60, inter-annotator PLCC of 0.78, inter-annotator SRCC of 0.50, pairwise accuracy of 0.76, and Δ \Delta -Pairwise@0.2 of 0.92.
The high ICC and margin-based pairwise agreement indicate stable aggregated human judgments, especially for samples with clear perceptual differences.

blocks.en:
Figure 7 summarizes the composition of AVC-Benchmark.
The 706 samples cover ground truth, JAVG, A2V, V2A, and explicitly constructed negative data.
Based on the human annotations, 678 samples (96.0%) exhibit multi-event composition, 322 (45.6%) contain multi-layer audio, and 376 (53.3%) contain diverse cross-modal relations.
The three complexity subsets are non-exclusive, allowing a sample to exhibit multiple forms of complexity simultaneously.
Together with the 39-label and human-score distributions, these statistics show that AVC-Benchmark covers different generation settings, failure patterns, and relation complexities.

706个样本覆盖了地上真相,JAVG,A2V,V2A,并明确构建了负数据.

这些统计与39-标签和人分分布一起,表明AVC-Benchmark涵盖了不同的代代设置,故障模式,以及关系的复杂性.

We further evaluate metric-to-human agreement on the three scene-complexity subsets derived from the human annotations.
The subsets are non-exclusive and correspond to the three properties motivating our evaluation design: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio, and diverse cross-modal relations.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价关于从人类说明中得出的三个场景复杂子集的衡量与人类的一致。
这些子集是非排他性的,符合激励我们评价设计的三个特性:多事件组成、多层次音频和多种跨模式关系。

blocks.en:
Table 17 shows that AVC-Reward achieves the highest Δ \Delta -Pairwise@0.2 on all three complexity subsets.
The margins are clearer on multi-event and multi-layer-audio samples, where AVC-Reward improves from the second-best results of 0.661 and 0.696 to 0.715 and 0.747, respectively.
On diverse-relation samples, AVC-Reward also gives the best pairwise agreement, although the margin over Qwen3-Omni-Thinking is smaller (0.703 vs. 0.698).
These results show that the event-centric evaluation is particularly effective for samples involving multiple events and layered audio, while retaining its advantage when audio and video are related through off-screen, narrative, or other non-trivial relations.
blocks.zh:
表17显示,AVC-Reward在所有三个复杂子集上实现最高的QQ\Delta-Pairwise@0.2.
在多事件和多层音频样本中,差值更为明确,AVC-Reward分别从0.661和0.696的第二好结果提高到了0.715和0.747。
在多种关系样本上,AVC-Reward还给出了最好的对等协议,虽然Qune3-Omni-Thinking的比值较小(0.703 vs. 6.698.).
这些结果显示,以事件为中心的评价对于涉及多起事件和分层音频的样本特别有效,同时在音频和视频通过外屏,叙事或其他非三角关系被关联时保留其优势.

Instead of directly measuring the correlation between predicted dimension scores
and human dimension scores, we formulate this analysis as a dimension-specific
issue classification task. Human dimension scores are mainly designed for
overall perceptual evaluation, and the three dimensions may have different
levels of granularity. Therefore, compared with continuous scores, human issue
labels provide a more direct signal for evaluating whether each predicted
dimension corresponds to its intended consistency dimension.

标签提供了一个更直接的信号,用于评估每个预测

blocks.en:
Fig. 8 shows a complete input–output example of AVC-Reward.
The clip contains a coherent kitchen scene with several events, including chef speech, chopping, and an off-screen phone ring.
The phone ring can plausibly originate outside the frame, but the visible chef shows no reaction or other visual evidence supporting its interaction with the scene.
AVC-Reward first analyzes the audio and video independently to extract their scenes and major events, and then performs audio-to-video and video-to-audio verification for the extracted events.
The final stage combines the scene-level information and cross-modal evidence to judge the three consistency dimensions.
The complete reasoning process is contained in the <think> block, followed by the three scores and a diagnostic conclusion.
blocks.zh:
图8显示了AVC-Reward的完整输入-输出示例.
片中包含一个连贯的厨房场景,包括厨师演讲,砍人等多起事件,以及一个外屏电话铃.
电话环可以合理地发源于帧外,但可见的主厨没有显示任何反应或其他支持其与场景互动的视觉证据.
AVC-Reward首先独立地分析音频和视频以取出他们的场景和重大事件,再对取出的事件进行音频到视频和视频到音频的验证.
最后阶段结合了场景层面的信息和跨模式证据来判断三个一致性维度.
完整的推理过程被包含在"想"块中,然后是三个分数和一个诊断结论.

blocks.en:
Fig. 9 , together with the evaluation cases in Fig. 5 , further shows how AVC-Reward handles different forms of complexity in generated audio-video content.
The two-person conversation case in Fig. 5 tests multi-event disentanglement: two people are visible, but the audio provides clear speech evidence for only one of them.
The puppet case tests multi-layer audio, where character speech, ambient factory sounds, and background music play different roles in the scene.
blocks.zh:
图9连同图5中的评价案例进一步显示AVC-Reward如何处理生成的音频视频内容中不同形式的复杂性.
Fig. 5的"双人对话"案例测试多事件分解:两人可见,但音频只为其中一人提供清晰的语音证据.
木偶案测试多层音频,其中人物演说,环境工厂声音,背景音乐在现场扮演不同角色.

blocks.en:
The additional cases extend this evaluation to several other situations.
The band case contains multiple instruments and vocals at the same time, testing concurrent event verification.
The choir case changes from a conductor to the singers and requires the evaluator to verify different valid audio-video relations across the clip.
The hammer case tests precise event-level temporal verification by introducing a clear delay between the visible impact and its sound.
The concert-ending case tests fine-grained visual evidence for sound production: the performance has ended and the orchestra begins packing up and bowing, although the performance audio continues.
Across these cases, AVC-Reward remains close to human judgments and provides conclusions that identify the relevant event or relation.
The positive choir and band examples further show that complex but valid relations can still receive high consistency judgments.
blocks.zh:
其他案例将这一评价扩大到其他一些情况。
乐队案例同时包含多个乐器和相声,测试同时发生的事件验证.
唱诗班案例从导师改为歌手,要求评价者验证跨片段的不同有效的音频-视频关系.
锤子案通过在可见撞击及其声音之间引入明显的延迟,测试精确的事件级时间核查.
演唱会终极案例测试精细的视觉证据来进行音效制作:表演已经结束,管弦乐团开始打包和鞠躬,尽管表演音频仍在继续.
在这些案件中,反证监会-奖励仍然接近于人类判决,并提供了确定相关事件或关系的结论。
积极的合唱团和乐队的例子进一步表明,复杂而有效的关系仍然可以得到高度一致的判断.

blocks.en:
Fig. 10 , together with the generation cases in Fig. 5 , shows how the same event-level evaluation capabilities are reflected in generation after using AVC-Reward for optimization.
In the dog–cat case in Fig. 5 , the optimized model better preserves sequential multi-event composition, with the dog and cat opening their mouths for their respective sounds.
In the cooking case, it better handles multi-layer audio by retaining narration while also generating visible chopping with synchronized chopping sounds.
blocks.zh:
图10与图5中的生成案例一起显示,在使用AVC-Reward进行优化后,同样的事件级评价能力如何被生成反应.
在Fig. 5中的"狗-猫案"中,优化后的模式更好地保留了相继的多事件组成,由狗和猫为各自的声音开口.
在烹饪箱中,它通过保留叙事来更好地处理多层音频,同时也会用同步切声产生可见的切声.

blocks.en:
The additional cases cover further generation complexities.
In the waterfall case, the optimized model preserves concurrent waterfall sound and human speech.
In the election-ad case, visual cuts, sound effects, footsteps, and narration form different event-dependent relations that are more consistently generated.
The water-pouring case shows finer audio attributes, where the water-flow sound changes with the evolving visual event.
The piano case shows finer visual evidence for sound production, with finger presses, key motion, and pitch changes forming a more coherent relation.
Together, these examples qualitatively mirror the capabilities examined by AVC-Reward: finer checks of individual events, their cross-modal relations, audio attributes, and visible sound-producing evidence lead to more complete event generation and more consistent audio-video relations.

blocks.en: F.1 Sampling and Annotation Protocol
blocks.zh: F.1 取样和注释议定书

blocks.en: We randomly sample 100 prompts from the three generation benchmarks with fixed coverage: 30 prompts from AVGenBench, 30 from AV-Phys-Bench, and 40 from VABench. For each prompt, we generate or collect one sample from each of LTX-2, OmniNFT, and Ours. Each case therefore contains three videos with the same English prompt. The three videos are shown as anonymous options A, B, and C in a randomized order, and model identities are hidden from annotators.
blocks.zh: 我们随机抽取了100个来自三代基准的有固定覆盖范围的提示:30个来自AVGen Bench,30个来自AV-Phys-Bench,40个来自VA Bench. 对于每个提示,我们生成或收集一个样本 从LTX-2,OmniNFT,和Ours。 因此,每个案件都包含三个视频,英语提示相同。 这三段视频以随机排列的顺序显示为匿名选项A,B和C,模型身份被从注释者处隐藏.

blocks.en: Ten annotators with at least a bachelor’s degree independently evaluate 30 cases each. The assignment is balanced so that every case is evaluated by exactly three annotators. Annotators answer two questions:

blocks.en: 1. Audio-video consistency. Which sample better matches sound events to the visible action in timing and attributes? The judgment also considers whether narration, off-screen sound, ambient sound, and background music are appropriate for the scene. 2. Overall quality. Which sample is better when audio quality, visual quality, and audio-video consistency are considered together?
blocks.zh: 1. 音频录像的一致性。 在时间和属性上,哪些样本能更好地匹配声音事件与可见动作? 判断中还考虑了叙述,外屏声音,环境声音,和背景音乐是否适合现场. 2. 总体质量。 将音频质量、视觉质量和音频视频一致性放在一起考虑,哪个样本更好?
